generation.purpose: AI multi-view 3D reconstruction and humanoid skeleton fitting

imageSpec.camera: orthographic model-sheet camera at fixed eye level

identity.notes: Cream forehead and muzzle, dark eye masks, amber eyes, eyebrows, nose, ears, fur palette and swept hair tuft remain locked across all six views.

costume.notes: Mustard hoodie, cream knit cardigan, brown cuffed trousers and cream sneakers are preserved. The canonical front and three-quarter construction has exactly three cardigan buttons; strict profiles naturally occlude part of that front-edge row.

proportions.notes: Head-to-body ratio, shoulder height, arm span, torso length, leg length and shoe scale remain visually stable across the view set.

viewCoverage.notes: Front, front-left three-quarter, both exact profiles, back-right three-quarter and exact back views are present.

pose.notes: All views use the same strict T-pose: arms at shoulder height, elbows and wrists straight, torso upright, legs separated and feet parallel. In exact profile views the arms correctly overlap along the camera axis.

framing.notes: All source views are 1024x1536 with centered full-body framing, complete fingertips, hair and shoe soles, and sufficient rigging margin.
